title: On some representations of Metacyclic groups whose integral forms can be computed from a single residual representation
summary: In a previous work we computed the number of integral forms, over its field of definition, of an irreducible representation of a dihedral group. Here we apply the theory of Bruhat-Tits buildings to give similar formulas for a wider family of metacyclic groups that have representations of arbitrarily large dimension. Occasionally, these formulas can be extended to groups containing a subgroup in that family.
